title: What Actually Happens If You Fall Into A Black Hole
hook: If you fell into a black hole, you wouldn't just die. You would witness the end of the universe.

scenes.text: If you fell into a black hole, you wouldn't just die. You would witness the end of the universe.
scenes.visual_prompt: lone astronaut in detailed white spacesuit floating in deep space facing a colossal glowing supermassive black hole with a blinding golden accretion disk bending space-time around it, Interstellar Gargantua aesthetic, volumetric lighting, photorealistic 8k vertical wallpaper, 9:16 vertical orientation

scenes.text: The moment you cross the Event Horizon, gravity becomes so infinitely intense that space and time literally swap places.
scenes.visual_prompt: extreme cinematic close-up of the pitch-black sphere of the event horizon, warped starlight curving in concentric rings of gravitational lensing, volumetric cosmic dust, deep space void, hyperrealistic 8k octane render, 9:16 vertical orientation

scenes.text: Your feet would feel billions of times more gravitational pull than your head, stretching your body into a single atomic string called Spaghettification.
scenes.visual_prompt: glowing celestial star getting ripped apart into ultra-thin glowing plasma ribbons spiraling into a massive black hole abyss, cosmic tidal disruption event, vivid orange and violet nebulae, 8k vertical wallpaper, 9:16 vertical orientation

scenes.text: To someone watching you from Earth, you would freeze on the edge forever. But to you, billions of years of cosmic history would flash by in seconds.
scenes.visual_prompt: space-time warping grid bending violently downward like a cosmic vortex, spiral galaxies spinning rapidly in the glowing background, Einstein general relativity visualization, cinematic dramatic lighting, 9:16 vertical orientation

scenes.text: At the singularity, the laws of physics shatter completely. Would you dare to jump in? Subscribe to explore the infinite cosmos.
scenes.visual_prompt: blinding point of pure infinite light at the heart of a cosmic void, emitting powerful relativistic plasma jets into the deep dark universe, epic cosmic masterpiece, 8k vertical wallpaper, 9:16 vertical orientation
